content:
If you know students who are interested in working on Lean or AI-assisted mathematics this summer, RenPhil has a number of funded placements available through the AI for Math Fund.

We're embedding several fellows directly within active research teams for 10 weeks. Positions touch on automated theorem proving, formal verification, formalization, and AI-assisted proof development, with several involving Lean directly. Full position details can be found at this link.

Key Details

  • Stipend: $20,000 - $30,000
  • Duration: 10 weeks (mid-June to August 2026)
  • Open to: Undergraduates, master’s students, and PhD students (dependent on project)
  • Format: Remote, hybrid, or in-person depending on host team

How to Apply

Submit an application via this webform by 2026-04-10T23:59:00-07:00 .

Hello, I was wondering based on what criteria applicants are selected. I’m a second-year undergraduate mathematics student and I’d like to apply, but I couldn’t fully understand the requirements or who gets selected. Could you help me?

I'm one of the host teams and I will simply interview a few people and then decide who I'd rather spend the summer working with. My decisions will be strongly based on things like Lean ability and relevant mathematical ability. But other teams might have different requirements.
Hi, i wanted to know when will we get to know if we got(or didnt) selected for the fellowship. Thanks!

that's a question for RenPhil not for this chat. I can tell you that for my position all the paperwork regarding decisions will be out of my intray by the end of April but what RenPhil then do with this data is up to them.
